response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 2014 role; their career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web technologies, with no evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial IoT protocols required for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Extensive background in event-driven systems and DevOps infrastructure
concerns: No demonstrable recent or deep C++/STL experience in scalable systems
Absence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or protocol exposure (OPC UA, Modbus, etc.)
Primary tech stack is web-focused (JS/TS/Node), not embedded or real-time C++
